# Rxova Journey

> A state machine for multi-step product flows — onboarding, checkout, auth,
> recovery — modelled as a graph of explicit transitions rather than a pointer
> into an array. Two kinds: a linear `["step1", "step2"]` list, or a branching
> graph with ordered transition matching and async guards.
> The runtime keeps one canonical snapshot — current step, realized history,
> context, visited state, status, async phase — so a flow can step back through
> its timeline and time-travel forward again. Persistence, analytics and replay
> are plugins, not baseline cost. Zero-dependency framework-agnostic
> core (7.58 kB brotli), thin typed React bindings, and a Chrome DevTools
> debugger. MIT.

This file is the map, not the manual. It exists because an agent that reaches
this project through the repository tree — rather than an install or the docs
site — has no index at all: `README.md` is written to persuade, `MANIFEST.MD`
explains why the library exists rather than how to call it, and `CONTRIBUTING.md`
is for somebody editing the runtime.

Deliberately pointer-only. Every fact about the API belongs to the generated
reference, which is checked against the source by `docs:api:check`; restating any
of it here would create a copy that nothing verifies and that drifts on the first
rename.

## Packages

- [@rxova/journey-core](packages/core): the runtime. One factory per journey
  kind, linear and graph. No framework, no dependencies.
- [@rxova/journey-react](packages/react): typed React bindings over the same
  runtime — a bundle around one standalone machine, deliberately thin.
- [@rxova/journey-devtools-bridge](packages/devtools-bridge): connects a running
  machine to the Chrome DevTools panel. Optional, and not imported by the core.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://rxova.org/packages/journey/): guides and the API
  reference, generated from the source.
- [Core: getting started](https://rxova.org/packages/journey/core/getting-started)

- [Snapshot](https://rxova.org/packages/journey/core/snapshot): the canonical
  read model, field by field — read this before writing calling code.
- [Async and guards](https://rxova.org/packages/journey/core/async) ·
  [History and the timeline](https://rxova.org/packages/journey/core/history)
  · [Plugins](https://rxova.org/packages/journey/core/plugins/overview/)
- [Stability](https://rxova.org/packages/journey/core/stability): what the
  version contract covers, and what it does not.
- [Pre-1.0 migration](https://rxova.org/packages/journey/core/pre-1-0-migration):
  the breaking changes, in order.
- [Chrome DevTools](https://rxova.org/packages/journey/devtool/overview) ·
  [Bridge API](https://rxova.org/packages/journey/bridge/bridge-api)
